correctness.rationale: For Pappus Levi graph with 9 points, 9 lines, 27 incidence edges, unordered configuration of two distinct geometric points admits the 153/432/297 cubical chain model under the graph subdivision criterion (girth six and essential vertices separated). Boundary signs are explicitly written in RESULT and verify_pappus.py. A separately written NetworkX/Sage-free sparse integer-mod-3 calculation rebuilt the 153 vertices, 432 edges and 297 squares and found boundary ranks (152,270), giving H1 dimension 10, H2 rank 27. Augmented transfer map rank 162 checked in source certificate implies rational H1 is naturally H1(graph), not simply inferred from Euler characteristic. A separate full 216-element graph automorphism enumeration and signed cellular Lefschetz computation returned 13 conjugacy classes with sizes (1,9,18,18,2,12,12,18,18,36,36,18,18) and H2 values (27,3,-3,-3,0,0,0,3,0,0,0,0,0). The source verifier explicitly tests full central multiplication identities and exact Q(sqrt3) orthogonality for six complex irreducibles, yielding rational degrees 1,4,4,6,12. Since H2 is kernel of an integer map from C2 and there are no C3, it is free Z^27. No claim on torsion of H1(Z) or integral equivariant extensions.
residual_risks: Rational irreducible decomposition relies on finite exact central algebra identities in pinned verifier, not an independent reimplementation of the entire 216x216 class algebra.
